death.attack.suchki.spell_wind: %1$s was torn apart by the wind
spell.suchki.shadow_bolt.desc: An instant piercing ray of darkness up to 40 blocks: 5 damage and Wither for 3 s, also hits a second target (3 damage); multicast fires a volley at different foes.
spell.suchki.drain_life.desc: While held, crimson threads (up to 20 blocks, up to 3 targets) draw 4 health per second from foes and heal you for 60% of it; overflow becomes up to 6 absorption; after 3 s a thread steals a positive effect.
spell.suchki.drain_life.chant: Blood, return to your true master.
spell.suchki.curse.desc: Curses a target (up to 48 blocks) for 15 s: +25% damage taken, Weakness and Slowness; if the cursed one dies, the seal jumps to a foe within 8 blocks.
spell.suchki.curse.chant: Let every step you take weigh more than stone.
spell.suchki.shadow_step.desc: Step through the shadows: behind a foe (up to 64 blocks) — your next melee hit within 2 s deals 6 more dark damage — or swap places with your own summon (up to 128); then 2 s of invisibility.
spell.suchki.shadow_step.chant: Shadow to shadow, step to step —|where you stand, there I already am.
spell.suchki.darkness.desc: A cloud of darkness of radius 5 at the crosshair (up to 64 blocks) for 8 s: foes go blind, wither, lose their target and cannot cast or shoot; those who leave wander confused for 2 more s.
spell.suchki.darkness.chant: Night, fall before your hour,|cover their eyes and steal their senses.
spell.suchki.soul_harvest.desc: Tears out the souls of foes within 12 blocks: 18 damage and Wither II for 6 s; each soul heals you for 2 (up to 10) and grants absorption, the slain drop half again as much experience.
spell.suchki.soul_harvest.chant: The reaper asks no names, the scythe is raised over the field.|Souls, part from your flesh|and return to me!
spell.suchki.grasp_heart.desc: Crushes the target's heart (up to 48 blocks): a mob with 45 health or less dies at once, otherwise 38 damage through armor and a 2 s stupor; bosses take 30, players 14 and nausea.
spell.suchki.grasp_heart.chant: I hear your heart beating, mortal,|thump — and my fingers rest upon it,|thump — and you understand who holds your life,|thump... and silence!
spell.suchki.black_coffin.desc: A 5×5×5 coffin of black gravity (up to 96 blocks) binds foes and after 1.5 s pierces them with spears of darkness: 34 damage, Wither II and Slowness IV; the ground inside is crushed.
spell.suchki.black_coffin.chant: Dark seal of pride, a vessel without a bottom.|Every breath a shackle, every step dust.|Four doorless walls rise from the earth.|Drown in black silence without hope!
spell.suchki.black_moonfang.desc: A giant black crescent with a crimson edge (12 wide) flies through everything for 96 blocks: 48 damage and bleeding for 5 s; it leaves a trench 64 blocks long.
spell.suchki.black_moonfang.chant: My soul is a blade, my blade a soul.|Darkness I clenched in my palm — be free.|Let the moon split the night in two.|Black blade, crimson edge —|Moonfang!
spell.suchki.malevolent_shrine.desc: An open domain of radius 24 for 8 s: endless invisible slashes cut every foe (about 80 damage and bleeding), ending in a giant cross slash; the terrain is diced to pieces.
spell.suchki.malevolent_shrine.chant: Finger by finger, curse by curse.|Beneath the sky there is no place that is not mine.|Bones for pillars, skulls for tiles,|let the shrine of malice open its gates.|Dismantle. Cleave. Without end.|Domain Expansion!
spell.suchki.firebolt.desc: A swift fire arrow flying 64 blocks: 6 fire damage and burning for 3 s; charged almost to the focus limit it overheats and pierces one target.
spell.suchki.flames.desc: While held, a jet of fire bursts 7 blocks from the staff: 6 damage per second and burning for 2 s; snow and ice at its tip melt.
spell.suchki.flash_fire_hand.desc: Marks up to 4 foes in a 28-block cone; 0.6 s later each mark detonates: 9 fire damage to the target, 4 to everyone within 2 blocks, and burning for 4 s.
spell.suchki.flash_fire_hand.chant: A crimson flower opens at my fingertips — one step, and the whole garden burns!
spell.suchki.fireball.desc: A fireball flies up to 64 blocks and bursts in a 3.5-block radius: 16 fire damage at the centre down to 8 at the edge, burning for 4 s and a small crater.
spell.suchki.fireball.chant: Flame, compress in my palm into a lesser sun,|break loose and bloom into a flower of fire!
spell.suchki.pillar_of_fire.desc: A 25-block pillar of flame erupts at the crosshair (up to 96 blocks): 22 fire damage, a launch and burning for 6 s; for 2 more seconds it deals 6 damage per second inside; the ground is scorched.
spell.suchki.pillar_of_fire.chant: Flame that sleeps in the heart of the earth,|hear my name and rise to the clouds —|become the column that holds up the sky!
spell.suchki.meteor_shower.desc: A sky circle 40 blocks above the target (up to 128 blocks) rains 10 meteors over 3.5 s — 18 damage in a 3-block radius each — then a great meteor: 36 damage in a 5-block radius, and craters.
spell.suchki.meteor_shower.chant: Stars slumbering beyond the firmament,|hear the call of one marked by flame,|tear from your orbits, burn white-hot,|and fall as a rain of retribution!
spell.suchki.sun_wheel.desc: A 3-block fire wheel rolls 48 blocks, climbing ledges and burning through walls: 28 fire damage and burning for 8 s, ending in a 4-block explosion for 14 damage.
spell.suchki.sun_wheel.chant: Seventh form of the solar flame.|A circle without beginning, heat without end,|roll across the land that dared to stand in the way,|and leave nothing but ash — Sun Wheel!
spell.suchki.heliogenesis.desc: A small sun is born 22 blocks above the target: for 2 s it burns everything within 14 blocks (3 damage per second), then falls — up to 55 damage in a 10-block radius, a flame mane out to 16 blocks for 8, and a crater of radius 8.
spell.suchki.heliogenesis.chant: Light born in the heart of the sky,|heat older than the world itself,|condense within my palms —|I grant you birth!|Blaze, little sun, and burn all that falls beneath your gaze!
spell.suchki.crimson_explosion.desc: Burns all your mana (at least 250): seven barrel circles toward the target, a 16-block blast — 160 damage at the centre down to 40 at the edge — a shockwave out to 48 blocks and a huge crater; then the caster is drained for 10 s.
spell.suchki.crimson_explosion.chant: Darkness blacker than night itself, crimson redder than blood,|I call to you, slumbering fire of creation,|awaken in the depths of my heart,|burn reason, burn fear, burn me to the very last drop,|let all that exists tremble before a single flash —|BURST!
spell.suchki.ice_shard.desc: An ice spike flying 48 blocks: 6 frost damage, pierces one target, Slowness II for 3 s; water in its path freezes into a 3×3 crossing for 10 s.
spell.suchki.deep_breath.desc: For 3 minutes: water breathing, dolphin's grace and conduit power (plus night vision at ×1.2 power); puts out fire; multicast copies bless allies within 6 blocks.
spell.suchki.frost_beak.desc: Three ice spears grow behind you and fly at the target one by one (up to 48 blocks): 7 frost damage and Slowness for 3 s each; if all three strike one foe it shatters for 4 more.
spell.suchki.frost_beak.chant: Beak of winter, pierce the warm flesh!
spell.suchki.frost_nova.desc: A ring of ice with radius 6 around you: 9 frost damage, Slowness III for 4 s, foes' feet freeze in place for 3 s, water within 8 blocks freezes for 10 s.
spell.suchki.frost_nova.chant: Moon that sleeps in the snow — open your eyes.|First dance: let everything turn white!
spell.suchki.frost_waltz.desc: Six ice lances circle you for 20 s: every half second one strikes the nearest foe within 14 blocks (7 frost damage), a lance shatters an enemy projectile, and the rest burst into shards at the end (3 damage within 3 blocks).
spell.suchki.frost_waltz.chant: Six lances of ice, whirl in a dance around me,|and pierce with winter all who enter the ring!
spell.suchki.glacier_ridge.desc: A glacier 5 wide and up to 6 high surges along a 40-block line (melts after 10 s): foes within 3 blocks of it take 14 frost damage and are frozen in place for 4 s.
spell.suchki.glacier_ridge.chant: Half of me is endless cold.|Let a northern glacier rise like a wall|and lock all living things in ice!
spell.suchki.cursed_crystal_prison.desc: Foes within 6 blocks of the target (up to 96 blocks away) take 20 frost damage and are sealed in crystal prisons for 8 s (4 damage per second); a prison bursts when time runs out or it takes a 10+ damage hit — 18 damage within 2.5 blocks, chaining to its neighbours.
spell.suchki.cursed_crystal_prison.chant: Cold older than the stars, come from the abyss of oblivion,|clothe my foes in crystal of silence,|let their hearts become facets of cursed stone,|and shatter, prison, when I open my hand!
spell.suchki.abyssal_wyrm_roar.desc: A water dragon tears 56 blocks ahead in a 4-wide lane: 22 water damage (double to fiery creatures and endermen), sweeps foes away and slows them for 4 s, puts out fire and turns lava to obsidian; with block damage on it rips through leaves, glass and grass.
spell.suchki.abyssal_wyrm_roar.chant: Lord of the depths, sleeping in the ocean's dark,|awaken and open wide your jaws,|let your roar become a deluge,|devour those who stand before me!
spell.suchki.hail_hammer.desc: Snow falls from a sky circle for 2.5 s (foes within 10 blocks are slowed and sprout ice flowers, 2 damage each), then a glacier drops: 40 frost damage at the centre and 16 at the edge of radius 8, +2 per flower, ice prisons for 4 s and a radius-5 crater bristling with ice spikes.
spell.suchki.hail_hammer.chant: Heaven, cool your heart.|Let the first snowflake touch their shoulders, and the hundredth their heart.|Merciless winter, forge a hammer of eternal ice,|let the sky be the anvil and the earth the thing that cracks.|Fall, frozen verdict!
spell.suchki.tidal_leviathan.desc: A tsunami 32 wide and 10 high rolls 80 blocks: 60 water damage and foes swept along, a crash of 40 damage within 12 blocks at the end, then the whole flooded strip flash-freezes: foes are locked in ice for 5 s and take 25 more frost damage as it thaws.
spell.suchki.tidal_leviathan.chant: Sea older than the shores, hear me from the depths,|Leviathan sleeping beneath a thousand waves — open your eyes,|lift the ocean upon your back|and bring it down upon the land as upon your prey,|and when the water recedes — let even the echo freeze.|Deluge of the Leviathan!
spell.suchki.telekinesis.desc: While held, an unseen hand drags items and XP within 3 blocks of your gaze (up to 32 blocks) to you; with none around it grabs a small creature (up to 30 health) and holds it 3 blocks ahead; let go to hurl it for 4 void damage on impact.
spell.suchki.blink.desc: Instantly moves you to the crosshair up to 16 blocks away (32 at ×2 power), keeping half your momentum, with 0.5 s of fall immunity; each multicast copy leaves a decoy afterimage at the departure point that draws foes for 3 s.
spell.suchki.blink.chant: Fold, o space — one step past the horizon!
spell.suchki.recall.desc: After a long ritual, carries you to your bed or respawn anchor (or the world spawn); sneak-cast to set a portable mark instead, which takes priority in its dimension; each multicast copy brings along a player within 4 blocks.
spell.suchki.recall.chant: The mark at my threshold calls to me —|distance, fold like paper: I am going home.
spell.suchki.door_crossing.desc: Two linked 2×3 doors — 2 blocks ahead of you and at the crosshair (up to 128 blocks) — for 15 s: creatures, items and projectiles pass through keeping their speed; recast closes them. Sneak-cast 'Hunting Ground': a door under a foe (up to 48 blocks) and its twin 25 blocks above it for 3 s.
spell.suchki.door_crossing.chant: Threshold to threshold, door to door —|distance, kneel before me.
spell.suchki.lapse_blue.desc: A point of attraction at the crosshair (up to 96 blocks) drags foes within 10 blocks and loot within 16 for 4 s; at the core 6 void damage per second and Slowness IV, then it collapses for 12 damage within 3 blocks, gouging a 2.5-block pit.
spell.suchki.lapse_blue.chant: Negative infinity, collapse into a point.|All that has weight — come to me.|Azure!
spell.suchki.reversal_red.desc: A red sphere of repulsion flies 64 blocks: 30 void damage to everyone in its path (20% less for each next one), hurling them aside, bores through up to 24 blocks of rock and bursts for up to 20 damage within 5 blocks, leaving a radius-4 crater.
spell.suchki.reversal_red.chant: Positive infinity, unfold.|All that stands in the way — away from me.|Expansion without limit, rejection without mercy.|Crimson!
spell.suchki.kamui.desc: A swirl of warped space holds the target at the crosshair (up to 96 blocks) for 1.5 s — 26 void damage, nearby projectiles vanish; mobs at 30% health or less (or with 24 max health or less) are banished for good, their loot dropping at your feet; others fall from 8 blocks up.
spell.suchki.kamui.chant: Eye that sees another world — open.|Space, curl into a spiral around him.|There is no place for you here.|Vanish into my dimension!
spell.suchki.time_stop.desc: Time halts within 48 blocks for 6 s (bosses 2 s): mobs, projectiles, items and TNT freeze, and all damage dealt to them lands at once when time resumes; other players are bogged down for 3 s; each multicast copy adds 1.5 s (up to 10 s).
spell.suchki.time_stop.chant: Hands of the eternal clock, be still,|sand, hang between the bulbs,|hearts, freeze between beats,|let the instant stretch into eternity —|and in that eternity, I alone move!
spell.suchki.reality_slash.desc: A cut through space 64 blocks long and 8 high (horizontal when sneaking): 64 void damage through any armor (40 to bosses), and the blocks in its plane vanish; multicast copies slash crosswise at 45°.
spell.suchki.reality_slash.chant: The world is a canvas stretched over the void,|and every canvas can be cut.|Armor is thread, shield is thread, flesh is but thread;|I draw a line — and it becomes truth.|Sever what is!
spell.suchki.planetary_devastation.desc: A black core rises 24 blocks above the crosshair (up to 128 blocks) and for 6 s drags foes and loot within 28 blocks into itself, tearing a radius-10 crater from the ground; near the core 5 damage every 0.5 s, then a crushing 60 damage within 10 blocks, and a stone moon of radius 7 hangs for 30 more seconds.
spell.suchki.planetary_devastation.chant: Earth, tear yourself from the earth.|Heaven, open your bottomless maw.|All that walks, crawls and flies —|become a single stone.|Let a new moon be born —|Planetary Devastation!
spell.suchki.healing.desc: While held, green light in your palm heals you for 2 health per second, or the ally in front of you (up to 6 blocks) for 2.4; every 3 s on one patient draws out one harmful effect.
spell.suchki.flower_field.desc: A meadow blooms around you in a 6-block radius: flowers on the grass, Regeneration I for 8 s and weaker poison and wither for allies, animals follow you for 10 s, undead are slowed for 3 s.
spell.suchki.heal_other.desc: Heals the ally under your crosshair (up to 48 blocks) for 9 health, removes one harmful effect and puts out fire; undead under the crosshair take 7 holy damage instead.
spell.suchki.cure.desc: Removes all harmful effects, fire and freezing, heals 4 health and wards off poison, wither and hunger for 5 s.
spell.suchki.cure.chant: Poison and curse, leave this body!
spell.suchki.rejuvenation.desc: You and allies within 8 blocks (pets and summons included) gain Regeneration II for 10 s and 3 health.
spell.suchki.rejuvenation.chant: Spring, come before your time,|let every heart beat stronger.
spell.suchki.healing_circle.desc: A 6-block wellspring at your crosshair (at your feet while sneaking) for 12 s: allies get 6 health on entry, then 2 per second and cleansing; undead burn for 4 per second, enemy projectiles burn away.
spell.suchki.healing_circle.chant: Pure water flowing from the goddess's heart,|wash the wounds, banish poison and curse,|and let flowers sprout from stone!
spell.suchki.undying.desc: For 60 s death steps back from you (or from the ally under your crosshair within 16 blocks): a lethal blow leaves half health, Regeneration II and Absorption II, and a golden burst throws back foes within 4 blocks.
spell.suchki.undying.chant: Seal that gathered strength for a hundred days —|open within me.|Let death come knocking —|I will not open the door!
spell.suchki.deep_forest_bloom.desc: A forest of 18 trees bursts from the ground at your crosshair (up to 96 blocks) in a 12-block radius: roots hold foes for 5 s, trunks strike for 12 and crush for 24 more after 3 s, allies gain 4 health and Regeneration II for 10 s.
spell.suchki.deep_forest_bloom.chant: Seed that slept a thousand years — awaken.|Roots, become chains.|Branches, become walls.|Forest born in a single instant,|take my enemies into your embrace!
spell.suchki.yggdrasil_bloom.desc: The World Tree rises at your crosshair (up to 128 blocks) for a minute: allies within 32 blocks are fully healed and gain Regeneration III, Absorption IV, the Seal of Undying and 30% mana, fallen pets return, and roots strike foes 7 times for 14 damage.
spell.suchki.yggdrasil_bloom.chant: Roots that hold the nine worlds,|branches that touch the stars,|hear the call of one who guards life,|let every wound close like a bud at dawn,|and every foe become soil for new roots.|Bloom, Yggdrasil!
